QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] A Gift for Mother
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bTess#k in #bAltaire Camp#k again to get some work to do.
QuestInfo.1:
Tess said there is no work to do and instead asked that you do something personal for him.
He wants to give his pregnant mother a flower as a gift.
Go to #bMushroom Hillside#k and get a #bFlower Bloomed in Mushroom Hill#k.
Then ask #bSion#k in the #bTent House#k to wrap the flower.
QuestInfo.2: You got the flower and went to Sion to get it wrapped. When you spoke with her, she was busy calming a crying baby, and asked that you help her with something.

0.msg: (After you obtained the the flower on the hill in #bMushroom Hillside#k, go to #bSion#k and ask her to wrap it.)
